newsitem.title: JAPAN: Lease Electronics bid-only after announcement.
newsitem.headline: Lease Electronics bid-only after announcement.

text.p: Shares of Lease Electronics Co Ltd were bid-only early on Wednesday morning following the company's announcement that the president of Sega Enterprises Ltd and other parties are planning to buy some of its shares.
At 0059 GMT, Lease Electronics was bid-only at 420 yen against Tuesday's close of 400 yen.

Lease Electronics announced on Tuesday that Sega President Hayao Nakayama, ADO Electronic Industrial Co Ltd and other parties were planning to buy about two million shares in Lease Electronics, or a stake of about 41.51 percent.
They would make the purchases at a price of 430 yen per share by next Tuesday, Lease Electronics said.
